title: card-loop author_clause result v1
description: Stage `author_clause` (design D4 clause items: PENDING -> AUTHORING -> SIM -> ORACLE). The worker wrote exam scenario file(s) for one printed clause in its worktree (`qa/dcgo-exams/<SET>/...yaml`, contract per the exam MCP `exam_authoring_guide`) and validated them with `exam_validate`. `scenario_paths`: repo-relative scenario files written. `covers`: clause ids the scenarios exercise (D8 `covers`, defaults to the item's clause). `notes`: anything the driver or a reviewer must know (empty string if none; if no scenario could be authored, `scenario_paths` is empty and `notes` says why). Strict-mode compatible.
